newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-STEFANEL AND KINDER SET UP ALL-ITALIAN DUEL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-STEFANEL AND KINDER SET UP ALL-ITALIAN DUEL.

text.p: Stefanel Milan lost to Germany's Alba Berlin and Kinder Bologna trounced Croatian side Split on Thursday to set up an all-Italian duel in the final 16 of the EuroLeague.

Stefanel finished first of Group E despite losing at home 91-80 to Germany's Alba Berlin, while a few kilometres (miles) south Kinder routed Split 73-57 to finish fourth in Group H and qualify for the next stage.
The winner of Group E faces Group H's fourth-placed team.

The Italians' European showdown next month promises to be a battle. The old rivals are also both fighting to knock Benetton Treviso off the top of the domestic league table where Kinder are currently second and Stefanel third.
Kinder, with inspirational play by veteran pivot Walter Magnifico (16 points and five rebounds) had little trouble against the Croatians, who finished fifth in Group H, just edged out by Kinder.
In Milan, Americans Warren Kidd grabbed 24 points and guard Anthony Bowie added 13 as Stefanel powered to a 49-45 halftime lead over Alba Berlin.

But when a back injury kept Milan pivot Gregor Fucka on the bench after the interval, Alba Berlin took immediate advantage of the gaping hole in their defence, scoring 13 unanswered points in the opening minutes of the second half.

The Italians, already winners of their group, struggled to keep up with Berlin, with Yugolsav playmaker Sasa Obradovic dishing out assists and netting 19 points to go with American Wendell Alexis's 20.
